summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq under QTEX, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing independent cryogenic testing of its additively manufactured electronics interconnect by an unnamed leading quantum computing company. Tests at 20 millikelvin showed channel-to-channel isolation above 100 dB across the 4-8 GHz qubit band, exceeding the published 40 dB crosstalk spec of leading flexible cryogenic cabling by over 60 dB, with stable impedance and repeatable performance across cooldowns. The parties are finalizing a binding definitive agreement; counterparty identity and terms to be disclosed within weeks. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, premium or board recommendation is stated; the item is an operational/technical milestone, so event-driven and risk-arb considerations do not apply.
